initial_turn.subject: Request for Quotation: Office Supplies and Miscellaneous Items
initial_turn.body:
Dear Sales Team,

I hope this message finds you well. We are currently in the process of restocking our office supplies and would appreciate your assistance with a formal quotation. For our upcoming quarter, we are looking to purchase a variety of items to support both our administrative and breakroom needs. To ensure we are budgeting appropriately, could you please provide pricing and availability for the following:

- 10 units of Screwdriver (we have previously ordered these, and they have worked well for our maintenance staff)
- 5 packs of Premium Copy Paper (preferably 500 sheets per pack; this is a standard item we use, but if you have different brands or options, please let us know)
- 2 boxes of Rasta Coffee Beans (our team really enjoys this blend, so we would like to continue with the same)

If you require any further details or clarification regarding the items listed, please do not hesitate to reach out. We are aiming to finalize our procurement by the end of next week, so a timely response would be greatly appreciated.

Best regards,
Dunder Mifflin
